name: Permanent Account Number (PAN, स्थायी लेखा नम्बर)
issuer: the Inland Revenue Department, through its Inland Revenue Offices and Taxpayer Service Offices
note: The Inland Revenue Department's frequently asked questions (ird.gov.np/faq, read 2026-10-30; the page carries no date): the PAN is a unique and permanent code given to every taxpayer for tax purposes, nine digits, generated by the computer system (example ३००३६२२५७), kept for life whatever changes; anyone who wants to earn assessable income the Department prescribes, or who must withhold tax on a payment, must take one before earning; since fiscal year 2066/67 (2009/10) a person with employment income must also take one, a personal PAN where there is one employer. A natural person applies with name, address, father's name, date of birth and citizenship or identity-card number, Nepali citizens with their citizenship certificate, foreigners with a passport or a diplomatic mission's identity card and their employer's recommendation; the office verifies the application and issues the PAN through the electronic system, online or at the office. Read as given on application, to anyone (citizens and foreigners alike), needed for work and tax. No check digit, age, fee or time is stated. Nepal's national identity number (the Department of National ID and Civil Registration's) isn't read here: its Act (2076) was saved but its text extracts in a legacy font and states no format.

sources.title: Inland Revenue Department, Nepal: Frequently asked questions (बारम्बार सोधिने प्रश्नहरू)
sources.said: कर प्रयोजनको लागि प्रत्येक करदातालाई पहिचान दिन दिइने अद्वितिय (Unique) र स्थायी (Permanent) संकेत हो । यो नौ (९) अंकको हुन्छ । ... कम्प्यूटर प्रणालीबाट सृजना हुने नौ अंकको स्थायी लेखा नम्बरको उदाहरणः ३००३६२२५७ ... रोजगारीको आय हुने व्यक्तिले पनि PAN लिनुपर्ने गरी आर्थिक वर्ष २०६६।६७ देखि व्यवस्था गरिएको छ।एउटै मात्र रोजगारदाता भएको अवस्थामा व्यक्तिगत PAN लिनुपर्दछ। ... स्थायी लेखा नम्बर अनिवार्य रुपमा लिनु पर्दछ। ... गैर नेपाली नागरिकको हकमा पासपोर्ट साइजको फोटो, निज कार्यरत रहेको कार्यालयको सिफारिस
